_note: SchedulerBindingSerializer shape + derived fields + pod queryset rule. Sources: app/serializers/scheduler.py:114-180. Method: serializer introspection + in-memory render under pi_dash.settings.test, cross-checked against contract BINDING_KEYS.

derived_fields.last_run_status: obj.last_run.status if obj.last_run_id else None (:175-176); status values are the AgentRun lowercase set (see F36-06)
derived_fields.pod_name: CharField(source='pod.name', read_only=True, default=None) (:130): pod name, or None when pod is NULL (DRF returns the default on the None traversal). QUIRK: the list join does not filter pod.deleted_at (see F36-05 R1), so a soft-deleted pod still renders its stale name here.
derived_fields.scheduler_color: CharField(source='scheduler.color', read_only=True) (:117); renders as stored (no case normalization)
derived_fields.series_exhausted: SerializerMethodField get_series_exhausted: False when next_run_at is set; else True iff next_fire_with_error(dtstart, rrule or '', tzid or 'UTC', rdates, exdates) returns (None, None) — a valid bundle with no occurrence after now (finite series finished / single-shot past). Parse error → False.

optional_with_model_default: pod (allow_null, default None = project default pod at fire time)
input_rules.read_only_sent: silently ignored (verified: next_run_at/actor in body are dropped; missing scheduler/project/dtstart still 400)
required: project (contract quirk: required in body even though the view pins the URL project at save - test_install_requires_project_in_body; explicit null passes, see F36-03 required)

pod_queryset_rule: PrimaryKeyRelatedField(queryset=Pod.objects.filter(deleted_at__isnull=True), required=False, allow_null=True) (:123-127): only active pods validate; a soft-deleted or unknown id -> 400 {'pod': ['Invalid pk ... - object does not exist.']}; NULL = use the project's default pod at fire time (:122). render_rules: id/scheduler/project/workspace/pod/last_run/actor render as UUID strings (PK fields) or null
datetimes (dtstart/next_run_at/last_run_ended_at/created_at/updated_at) render ISO-8601 with Z suffix
rdates/exdates render the stored JSON lists verbatim
output key order == fields list order
